_metadata.description: Service Interface Contract - Embedded architectural contract that warns LLMs before making breaking changes AND anchors LLM to Reflow workflow context
_metadata.purpose: Proactive drift prevention + context anchoring to prevent LLM tunnel vision during development

reflow_workflow_anchor._purpose: This section reminds LLM agents they are executing a Reflow workflow, preventing context drift during long development sessions
reflow_workflow_anchor.message: You are executing a Reflow workflow. This SERVICE_CONTRACT.json is your anchor to the system architecture.
before_any_modification: 2. CHECK: Does your change affect contracted_functions? If yes, STOP - update functional architecture first
3. CHECK: Does your change affect contracted_interfaces? If yes, STOP - this is a BREAKING change
4. CHECK: Are you adding new dependencies (consuming new interfaces)? If yes, update system_of_systems_graph.json first
5. UPDATE: context/working_memory.json with your current action (prevents drift)

context_refresh_trigger.description: If you've been coding for a while and aren't sure what workflow step you're on:
actions: VERIFY: What is my current Reflow workflow step?
VERIFY: What validation gate do I need to pass next?

drift_check_questions: What Reflow workflow step am I currently executing?
What service am I working on and what are its contracted functions?
What is the next validation gate I need to pass?

_instructions.usage: This template generates SERVICE_CONTRACT.json files for each service
_instructions.when_to_generate: D-02-A05 (after domain model implementation, before integration surfaces)
_instructions.when_to_update: D-06.5-A04.5 (when architecture changes during synchronization loop)

architecture_reference.description: Pointer to the authoritative system architecture that defines this service

contracted_functions.description: Functions this service MUST implement (from functional architecture)
contracted_functions.warning: DO NOT add, remove, or substantially modify these functions without updating the functional architecture (specs/machine/service_arch/) and regenerating the system of systems graph. Changes to contracted functions may break dependent services.

contracted_interfaces.description: Interfaces this service MUST provide and consume

provides.breaking_change_impact: Modifying this interface affects {N} consumer services

contracted_interfaces.warning: DO NOT modify provided interfaces without updating ICDs and notifying consumer services. DO NOT modify consumed interfaces - contact the provider service owner instead. All interface changes require re-running systems engineering workflows (01b or 01c).

llm_warnings.before_modifying_functions: ⚠️  WARNING: This service has {N} contracted functions. Adding, removing, or substantially changing function behavior requires updating the functional architecture. Run workflow 01d-functional_analysis or 01b/01c to update architecture first, then regenerate this contract.
llm_warnings.before_modifying_interfaces: ⚠️  WARNING: This service provides {N} interfaces consumed by {M} services. Interface changes are BREAKING changes. Update ICDs (specs/machine/interfaces/), notify consumers, and re-run systems engineering workflows before making changes.
llm_warnings.before_adding_dependencies: ⚠️  WARNING: Adding new service dependencies (consuming new interfaces) changes the system architecture. Update the system of systems graph and interface registry before adding imports or API clients.
llm_warnings.drift_detection: If you see differences between this contract and the actual implementation, run D-06 (As-Built Architecture Generation) and D-06.5 (Architecture Synchronization Loop) to reconcile the drift.

_usage_note: This contract is generated from service_architecture.json and system_of_systems_graph.json. It serves as an architectural 'hook' to prevent LLMs from making breaking changes without updating the system architecture. If this contract is out of sync with reality, run D-06.5 Architecture Synchronization Loop to reconcile.
